We decided to name him Granté, and together we passed the time as a happy family at Akkala Ancient Tech Lab.|Robbie's Memoirs|BotW}} * [[Jerrin]] {{Small|(mother)}} }} |voiceactor= |theme= |counter= }} {{Term/Store|Grantéson||Series, TotK}},{{Exp Game|TotK}}{{Cite|Grantéson|Game Screen|TotK}} also known as {{Term/Store|Granté||BotW}},{{Exp Game|BotW}}{{Cite|Granté|Game Screen|BotW}} is a recurring character in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Biography== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Granté is a half-[[Hylian]], half-[[Sheikah]] merchant, who is the son of the researchers [[Robbie]] and [[Jerrin]]. Robbie recalls that Granté grew quickly, and he used to train his body by carrying the [[Blue Flame]] from [[Tumlea Heights]].{{Cite|Granté grew fast, and it wasn’t long before he towered over me! He loved to carry the blue flame from Tumlea Heights, calling it a chance to train his body.|Robbie's Memoirs|BotW}} Before Granté left the [[Akkala Ancient Tech Lab]], Robbie wrote to [[Purah]] to ask if he could study with her at the [[Hateno Ancient Tech Lab]], but she refused any guests.{{Cite|A few days before he left, I thought it might be a good idea to have Granté study with Dr. Purah. I wrote to her to ask what she thought of such an idea, and she sent a letter that simply said… "Don’t send anyone here!"|Robbie's Memoirs|BotW}} Seeing Granté's curiosity, Robbie encouraged him to travel.{{Cite|I could see the curiosity in his eyes, and so I encouraged him to travel the world and see as much as he could.|Robbie's Memoirs|BotW}}{{Cite|That's why my father told me to go out and see the world!|Granté|BotW}} On the day his father suggested he should explore the outside world, Granté left his home.{{Cite|He'd always been independent. But I was still surprised when, the very day I told him to travel, he left!|Robbie's Memoirs|BotW}} During this time, he traveled the world whilst studying ancient civilizations.{{Cite|I'm Granté, a dashing, novice researcher of ancient civilizations! I've still got a lot to learn, though...|Grantéson|BotW}} Granté appears on the porch of one of the [[House]]s in [[Tarrey Town]] after the "[[From the Ground Up]]" [[Side Quest]] is complete. When [[Link]] first meets Granté, he asks if he is also traveling throughout the world.{{Cite|Are you also making your way through the world?|Grantéson|BotW}} If Link says he is doing something like that, Granté is excited to meet someone else like him.{{Cite|Oh! You too, huh? I’m beside myself with glee!|Grantéson|BotW}} Granté sells [[Armor Set]]s to Link that have no other method of being replaced after Link loses them,{{Cite|Do you want to take a look at my rare-armor collection? It's incredible|Grantéson|BotW}} such as Expansion Pass Armor Sets or those found within [[Ancient Shrine]]s.{{Cite|I got a complete set of this rare gear. It's {{Color BotW|Red|rubber}}...something-something.|Grantéson|BotW}}{{Cite|A complete set of rare gear, called {{Color BotW|Red|barbarian}}...something or other.|Grantéson|BotW}} However, he is unable to sell [[Armor]]s that Link has not previously obtained.{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 348}}{{Cite|I'm looking to get a set of rare armor in stock soon! It's called...umm...{{Color BotW|Red|climb}} something or other...|Grantéson|BotW}} He will also sell Link a new [[Hylian Shield]] for 3,000 [[Rupee]]s if the original is lost or broken. Link can also sell [[Item]]s to Granté. He asks to see what Link has,{{Cite|How about in your pouch?|Grantéson|BotW}}{{Cite|Please show me!|Grantéson|BotW}} in addition to warning him not to make a mistake when choosing what to sell.{{Cite|Don't make a mistake when choosing!|Grantéson|BotW}} ====Wares and Pricing==== {{Wares|game= BotW |collapse= true |- |{{Wares/Item |item= Old Shirt |price= 50 |stock= 1 |description= A thin shirt made long ago. They tell me he's so desperate for a job that he even changed his name! Don't ask me to what though.|Nikki|TotK}} He helps [[Link]] build his [[House]] during the "[[Home on Arrange]]" [[Side Quest]] by selling him rooms to use for House building, as well as verifying the House meets the construction guidelines. ==Nomenclature== Grantéson's name is derived from {{Wp|pomegranate}}. As of {{TotK}}, he has added the "-son" suffix to his name, signifying his employment by [[Hudson Construction]]. {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Hylian * Jerrin * Robbie * Sheikah * Tarrey Town }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Hudson Construction, Hylians, Hyruleans, Merchants, Researchers, Sheikah |characters= TotK }} [[de:Gratian]]
